_comment: Hand-labeled validation set for the small-business filter. ~156 real NYC-area storefronts labeled chain/local. The REGISTRY layer (seeded brand list) is measured against this set in test_classifier.py: recall floor 0.80, false positives must be 0. Chains the registry misses (block 2: off-list brands like Bluestone Lane, Blank Street) are the Gemini layer's job, validated behaviorally with canned responses — never quoted as a percentage. Fields mirror what Google Places returns at search time; counts/ratings are realistic approximations.
